title: Manage inventory order fulfillment and returns
summary: When the company holds physical stock or is responsible for delivering physical customer orders. Reconciled stock and order records with accepted delivery, returns and discrepancies assigned.
outcomes: Reconciled stock and order records with accepted delivery, returns and discrepancies assigned.
guidance: Start with the applicability facts and evidence listed in the first step. Resolve missing facts before authorizing the affected work. Completion requires the documented outcome, including tracked exceptions; starting an application or recording a task is not evidence of completion.
when: When the company holds physical stock or is responsible for delivering physical customer orders.

parts.title: Reconcile items, locations and demand
parts.guidance: Maintain item identifiers, stock locations, available and reserved quantities, lead times and order commitments. Distinguish accepted stock from quarantine, damaged or consigned goods.

execution.rationale: Prepare or reconcile the specified private evidence and documents; external changes and decisions use their own approved steps.

parts.title: Approve inventory and fulfillment controls
parts.guidance: Operations and finance agree purchasing authority, reorder assumptions, custody, picking checks and reconciliation cadence. Review product, customs and customer commitments with specialists where required.

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the decision, expert assessment or personal interaction described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

parts.title: Process the authorized order and dispatch records
parts.guidance: Authorized operators validate the order, payment or credit approval, item and destination before release. Record lot or serial traceability and the agreed carrier and delivery evidence.

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the reviewed account operation described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

approval.scope: Process the authorized order and dispatch records

parts.title: Handle delivery exceptions and returns
parts.guidance: Verify the customer, product and reason for any return or failed delivery. Use approved inspection, quarantine, refund and replacement decisions rather than returning potentially unsafe product directly to available stock.

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the physical work and checks described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

parts.title: Reconcile stock, customer balances and losses
parts.guidance: Match physical counts, movements, receipts and credits with the systems and ledger. Investigate discrepancies, approve adjustments through the responsible owner and update replenishment and quality actions.

execution.rationale: Prepare or reconcile the specified private evidence and documents; external changes and decisions use their own approved steps.

verify.how: Reconciled stock and order records with accepted delivery, returns and discrepancies assigned.
